newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-REAL HELD AT HOME BY STRUGGLING LOGRONES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-REAL HELD AT HOME BY STRUGGLING LOGRONES.

text.p: Real Madrid squandered a golden opportunity to draw level with leaders Barcelona when they were held to a goalless home draw by struggling Logrones in the Spanish league on Sunday.

It was Real's second consecutive 0-0 draw in the Santiago Bernabeu stadium, and stunned fans hoping to see a goal avalanche against a side who lost 8-0 to Barcelona and 6-0 to Athletic Bilbao in recent weeks.
The result leaves Real with 26 points from 12 games, two points behind Barcelona, who drew 3-3 with Atletico Madrid on Saturday, and one ahead of Deportivo Coruna, who play Tenerife later on Sunday.
Real Betis moved up to fourth, six points off the pace, after coming from behind to win 2-1 against Real Sociedad.
